# Get-On UI Specification v1 - Publishing

This document covers publishing a website to `https://{name}.get-on.tech`, the published site itself, the publishing dashboard UI and the safety and moderation screens. It extends `docs/ui-spec.md` (app scaffolding, auth, landing, dashboard, wizard, project area), `docs/ui-spec-app.md` (the dashboard app refresh) and `docs/ui-spec-editor.md` (the editor, site look, images library, version history and preview).

Sections 6.10, 8 and 9 of the publishing specification are recorded here word for word.

## 6.10 Platform pages (HTML generated by `packages/site-server`, no JavaScript, inline CSS)

Shared look for all three: page bg `#FFFBF5`, text `#1F1A17`, font stack `Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif` (use the shared Figtree WOFF2 with a fallback), centred column (max-width 480, padding 24, min-height 100dvh, flex column, justify centre). Order: icon circle (80x80, radius 999, bg `#FDEFC9`, inline SVG icon 40 `#7A4A00`), H1 (28/34, weight 700, margin-top 24), paragraph (17/1.6, `#6B6158`, margin-top 12), primary link button (height 52, padding 0 28, radius 12, bg `#0B6B4F`, white text 16/600, margin-top 28), then footer line (14, `#6B6158`, margin-top 40) "Made with Get-On" linking to `https://get-on.tech`. Dark mode is not needed here.
- **Not found** (unknown host, reserved host or unpublished): icon compass; H1 "We could not find this website"; text "The address may be misspelt, or the website has not been published yet."; button "Go to Get-On" to `https://get-on.tech`.
- **Not published yet** is the same as above when the site exists but is not live (state `unpublished`): H1 "This website is not live yet"; text "The owner has not published it, or has taken it offline for now."; same button.
- **Suspended:** icon shield-alert; H1 "This website is not available"; text "It has been taken offline because it broke our rules or is being reviewed."; button "Report a problem" to `https://get-on.tech/report?site={name}`.
- Site 404 (inside a live site): uses the site's theme with header and footer, one centred section (padding 96 20): H1 (heading font, 40/1.1) "Page not found", text "That page does not exist. It may have been moved or removed.", a solid button "Go to the homepage" linking to `/`.

## 8. Dashboard UI specification (atom level)

All values follow `docs/ui-spec.md` and `docs/ui-spec-app.md`. Components referenced (Button, Input, Badge, Dialog, Menu, Toast, InfoBox, Card, SettingsSection, PageHeader, AppPage) already exist; reuse them.

### 8.1 Site status model and badges
States and their badge (height 24, padding 0 10, radius 999, 12/700):
| State | When | Badge | Sentence used under or next to it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Not published | never published | Draft variant (warning soft), text "Not published" | "Not live yet" |
| Live | live and no unpublished changes | Live variant (success soft with an 8 px dot), text "Live" | "Live. Published {relative time}" |
| Live with changes | live and unpublished changes | Accent variant, text "Live, with changes" | "You have changes that are not published yet" |
| Offline | unpublished after being live | Neutral variant, text "Offline" | "Taken offline on {date}" |
| Under review | `review_state = 'pending'` | Info variant (`--info-soft`, `--info-text`), text "Under review" | "We are taking a quick look before it goes live" |
| Suspended | suspended | Danger variant (`--danger-soft`, `--danger-text`), text "Suspended" | "This website has been taken offline" |
Every place that showed the draft or live badge before (website cards, project sidebar status line, overview, pages list header) uses this model through one `SiteStatus` component with props `compact` (badge only) and `full` (badge plus sentence).

### 8.2 Publish buttons (all entry points use one `PublishButton` component)
Locations: editor top bar (replaces the disabled button), project sidebar bottom block, project Overview header action, Settings, Publishing tab, and mobile overflow menus.
- Label and look by state: Not published or Offline: primary md "Publish" with rocket icon. Live: primary md "Publish changes" with refresh-cw icon, shown only when there are unpublished changes; when there are none it becomes secondary md "Open website" with external-link icon (opens the live address in a new tab) and a neutral "Up to date" check text beside it (desktop only, 14 `--text-muted`, check-circle 16 `--success`). Under review: secondary md "Under review" disabled with clock icon and tooltip "We will email you when it is approved." (no email is sent yet; use "We will let you know here when it is approved." instead). Suspended: danger secondary md disabled "Suspended". Viewer role: hidden.
- Disabled while a publish is building: primary md with spinner 18 and label "Publishing...", `aria-busy`.
- In the editor top bar the button keeps its existing slot and sizes; on mobile the editor overflow menu gets a "Publish" item (rocket icon, 44 high) at the top.
- A small dot (8 px, `--accent`, top-right of the button, 2 px ring in the bar colour) shows on "Publish" and "Publish changes" when the site has never been published or has unpublished changes (hidden when a publish is building).
- Clicking opens the Publish dialog (8.3), except "Open website".

### 8.3 Publish dialog (pre-flight)
Dialog width 480 (bottom sheet on mobile), radius 24, padding 28 (24 on mobile). Layout top to bottom:
1. Header row: 48 circle (bg `--primary-soft`, rocket icon 24 `--primary`), then H3 "Publish your website" (first time) or "Publish your changes" (later) and a close x (44x44, top-right).
2. Address card (margin-top 20): bg `--surface-muted`, radius 16, padding 14 16: caption 12 caps "YOUR WEB ADDRESS", address 18/600 `--primary` (`rosebakery.get-on.tech`) with `word-break: break-all`.
3. Summary line (margin-top 16, 15 `--text-muted`): first time: "{n} page{s} will go live. You can change it any time and publish again." Later: "{n} page{s} will be updated. Your website stays online while we do this."
4. **Checks list** (margin-top 20): label "Before you publish" (12/700 caps). Each result as a row (min-height 56, padding 12 0, top divider 1px `--border` except first): left 24 px status icon (block: x-circle `--danger`; warn: alert-triangle `--warning-text`; info: info `--info-text`), middle title 15/600 and detail 14 `--text-muted`, right a "Fix" ghost sm button (when `fixLink` exists; navigates and closes the dialog). When all pass: single row with check-circle `--success` and "Everything looks good." Collapse long warning lists to the first 3 with a "Show {n} more" text button (14, `--primary`).
   - Contact form warning: when a page contains a contact form block but the Contact plugin is off, show a warning "Your contact form is turned off" with detail "Visitors will not be able to send you a message." and a "Turn it on" ghost sm link to `/plugins?enable=contact`. Publishing is still allowed; the block renders as plain text until the plugin is on.
5. If blocking results exist: replace the Publish button with a disabled primary lg "Fix the problems above first" (full width) and show an InfoBox when the reason is the email: "Please confirm your email first. We sent a link to {email}." with a "Send the email again" secondary sm button (success toast "Email sent. Check your inbox.", 60 second cooldown with a visible countdown).
6. Footer buttons (margin-top 24; right-aligned on desktop, stacked full width on mobile with primary on top): "Cancel" secondary md, "Publish now" primary md with rocket icon (label "Publish changes" in later publishes; with warnings present the label stays the same and a small 13 `--text-muted` note above the buttons reads "You can publish with warnings and fix them later.").
7. The dialog runs the checks on open (skeleton rows for 300 ms minimum to avoid flicker, three 56 px shimmer rows).
8. Under review: the dialog opens with an InfoBox (info variant): "We are taking a quick look at your website before it goes live. This usually takes up to 1 working day." and only a "Close" button.
9. Suspended: danger InfoBox "This website has been taken offline." with the reason from `suspended_reason` (plain text) and a "Contact support" secondary md button that opens the Help panel.

### 8.4 Progress view
When "Publish now" is pressed the same dialog content swaps (no new dialog, fade 120 ms), close x hidden, Escape disabled:
- Title H3 "Publishing..." and text 15 `--text-muted` "This takes a few seconds. You can keep this window open."
- Vertical step list (margin-top 24, gap 16): each row 28 px circle + label 15/500. Done step: filled `--success` circle with white check; current step: `--primary` ring with a 14 px spinner; upcoming: 2px `--border-strong` ring and label `--text-muted`. Connector line 2 px `--border` between circles (done segments `--success`).
- Below (margin-top 24): a progress bar with percentage derived from steps (checking 10, pictures 40, building 65, uploading 90, finishing 98, done 100); `role="progressbar"`.
- Polling every 1 s; if no change for 90 seconds show an InfoBox warning "This is taking longer than usual. You can close this window; we will keep going." with a "Close" button.
- On failure: swap to an error view: 56 circle `--danger-soft` with alert-circle 28 `--danger`, H3 "We could not publish your website", text from the error map, small muted "Reference: {first 8 characters of publish id}", buttons "Try again" (primary md) and "Close" (secondary md); live site untouched, with the sentence "Your website that is live right now has not changed." (shown when one is live).
- On "no changes": view with check-circle `--success` and text "Nothing has changed since your last publish. Your website is up to date." and a "Close" button.

### 8.5 Success view (first publish) and update view
- **First publish:** content swaps to a celebration layout (dialog width 520). Top: 72 circle `--success-soft` with check icon 36 `--success` (a one-time 400 ms scale-in; none with reduced motion). H2 (24) "Your website is live!", text 16 `--text-muted` "Anyone can now visit it at this address. It may take up to a minute to show everywhere."
  - Address row (margin-top 20): input-like box (height 52, radius 12, bg `--surface-muted`, 1px `--border`, padding 0 8 0 16, flex): address text 17/600 `--primary` truncated, and a "Copy" secondary sm button (copy icon, toast "Address copied.").
  - Action buttons (margin-top 16): "Open my website" primary lg full width (external-link icon, new tab); below it (margin-top 12) two secondary md buttons in a 2-column grid gap 12: "Share on WhatsApp" (message-circle icon in `#1FA855`; opens `https://wa.me/?text=` with the text "Visit {business name} online: {url}" URL-encoded) and "Download QR code" (qr-code icon).
  - QR code: generated client-side (`qrcode` package, lazy loaded only when this view opens), shown in a 160x160 box (padding 12, radius 16, bg `#FFFFFF`, 1px `--border`, centred, margin-top 20) with caption 13 `--text-muted` "Scan to open your website. Print it for your shop window." The download saves a 1024x1024 PNG named `{subdomain}-qr.png` with a 4-module quiet zone and error correction level M.
  - Footer: "Done" ghost md centred (margin-top 20).
  - Also set `localStorage` key `gs_celebrated:{projectId}` so the celebration shows only once per project.
- **Later publishes:** a compact view: check-circle 48 `--success`, H3 "Your changes are live", text 15 `--text-muted` "It may take up to a minute to show everywhere.", buttons "Open my website" (primary md) and "Done" (secondary md); an auto-dismiss toast "Published." is also shown after closing.

### 8.6 Live card on the project Overview
Replace the "Your web address" aside card with a larger status card at the top of the aside (and as the first card on mobile above the checklist):
- Card padding 20, radius 16. Top row: `SiteStatus full` (badge and sentence).
- Address row (margin-top 16): 44 high box (radius 12, bg `--surface-muted`, padding 0 12), globe icon 16, address 15/600 `--primary` truncated; right "Copy" ghost sm.
- Buttons (margin-top 16, stacked, gap 8): the `PublishButton` (md, full width), and when live "Open website" ghost md full width (external-link icon) unless the primary is already "Open website".
- When "Live with changes": below the buttons an InfoBox accent variant (padding 12 14, radius 12, bg `--accent-soft`, text 14 `--accent-text`) "You have changes that are not published yet." with a "See what changed" text button (14, underlined) that opens Settings, Publishing tab.
- When "Under review" or "Suspended": the matching InfoBox (info or danger variant) with the plain sentence and a "Contact support" ghost sm button (opens Help).
- Kebab menu (40x40, top-right of the card): "Open website" (when live), "Copy address", "Take offline" (when live; destructive style), "Publishing history".

### 8.7 "Take offline" dialog
Dialog 440: 48 circle `--warning-soft` with power icon 24 `--warning-text`; H3 "Take {name} offline?"; text 16 `--text-muted` "People who visit {address} will see a page saying your website is not live. You can publish again at any time. Your pages and pictures are kept."; buttons "Cancel" secondary md and "Take offline" danger md (loading "Taking offline..."); success toast "Your website is offline." with an "Undo" action (8 seconds) that republishes the previous live version using the rollback function.

### 8.8 Settings (project) with four tabs
Enable the sidebar "Settings" item (remove its "Soon" pill) and add routes `.../settings` (redirect to `business`), `.../settings/business`, `.../settings/search`, `.../settings/address`, `.../settings/publishing`. Page container `default` (960). `PageHeader`: breadcrumbs "{Team} / {Project} / Settings"; title "Settings"; description "Details and options for {project name}."; tab row (links, `aria-current`): "Business", "Search", "Address", "Publishing". Mobile: the tab row scrolls horizontally inside its container with an 24 px right fade and no visible scrollbar; the active tab scrolls into view.
All forms use `SettingsSection` rows inside one Card (padding 24, 1px dividers with 32 padding between sections). One sticky **save bar** per tab appears at the bottom when there are unsaved edits: fixed above the mobile tab bar (bottom: 64 plus safe area) or bottom 0 on desktop within the content column; height 64, bg `--surface`, top border 1px `--border`, shadow raised up, padding 0 20, flex space-between: left text 14 "You have unsaved changes", right "Discard" ghost md and "Save changes" primary md (loading "Saving..."). Saving shows toast "Saved." The unsaved-changes guard from the app spec applies.

**8.8.1 Business tab**
1. Section "Business name" (left 4 columns: label 15/600 "Business name", description 14 `--text-muted` "Shown in your website header and footer."; right 8 columns): Input (2 to 80 characters).
2. Section "Logo": left label "Logo" and description "Shown in your website header and used for your browser tab icon."; right the existing logo uploader (dropzone or preview with "Change" and "Remove"), square crop hint "A square picture works best."
3. Section "Contact details": Phone, Email, Address, Opening hours (Textarea 3 rows) each with helper text; description "These can be used in your contact section and in Google results."
4. Section "Business type": Select from the shared list; description "Helps us suggest wording."
5. Section "Language": Select (English, Français, Español, Português, Deutsch, Italiano, Kiswahili), description "The language your website is written in. This helps Google show it to the right people." (stored as codes, labels shown in their own language).
Data comes from and writes to `project_settings`; changes mark the site as having unpublished changes.

**8.8.2 Search tab**
1. InfoBox info variant at the top: "This is how your website looks in Google and when someone shares it. Good titles and descriptions help people find you."
2. Section "Website title": Input with a character counter, helper "Shown as the big blue link in Google. Around 50 to 60 characters works best." Placeholder shows the default (business name).
3. Section "Website description": Textarea (3 rows) with counter, helper "A short sentence that tells people what you do. Around 120 to 160 characters works best."
4. **Search preview** card directly under the two fields (see 8.9.2 for the component), showing the homepage.
5. Section "Picture when shared": left description "Shown when your link is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook and other apps."; right an Image field (opens the image picker) and a 1200x630 preview box (aspect 1.91:1, radius 12, 1px `--border`; empty state dashed with image icon and "We will use your first picture or your logo" 13 `--text-muted`).
6. Section "Let Google find my website": a switch row, default on, helper "Turn this off if you do not want your website to appear in search results." When turned off show an InfoBox warning "Your website will not appear in Google. Anyone with the link can still visit it." with a "Turn it back on" text button.
7. A collapsible "Advanced" (native `details`, summary 15/600 with chevron, bordered row): shows the sitemap address `https://{address}/sitemap.xml` with a Copy button and the text "We create and update this for you automatically. Google uses it to find your pages."; and the `robots.txt` address in the same style.

**8.8.3 Address tab**
- Card: label caption "Your free web address"; address 20/700 `--primary` with Copy and Open buttons (Open `aria-disabled` when not live); a muted line "This address is free and comes with your plan."
- InfoBox neutral (bg `--surface-muted`): "You cannot change this address yet. If you need a different one, contact us." with "Contact support" ghost sm (opens Help).
- **Your own domain** card (margin-top 24): lock or globe icon tile 48 (bg `--accent-soft`), title "Use your own domain", text "Use an address like yourbusiness.com instead of {address}." Free plan: accent pill "Basic plan and above", button "See plans" secondary md; paid plans: neutral pill "Coming soon" and a disabled button.

**8.8.4 Publishing tab**
1. **Status card** (same content as 8.6, but wider): two-column on desktop (left status and address, right buttons).
2. Section "Version history" (title 18/700, description 14 `--text-muted` "Go back to an earlier version of your live website. This does not change what you are editing."). List Card padding 0: rows (min-height 72, padding 12 20, top divider): left date and time 15/600 ("Today, 3:42 PM", "12 Oct, 4:05 PM"), then 13 `--text-muted` "{n} pages · {size}" and the note "No changes" is never listed; right a status: "Live now" success badge for the live row, "Restore" secondary sm for others (disabled with tooltip when expired; text "Too old to restore" 13 `--text-muted`). Failed publishes appear with a danger badge "Failed" and no action (details in a tooltip with the reference). Show the latest 10; empty state "Nothing published yet" with rocket icon 40 in a 72 circle and a "Publish" primary md button.
3. Restore confirmation dialog 440: H3 "Go back to this version?", text 16 `--text-muted` "Your live website will go back to how it was on {date and time}. What you are editing now is not changed, and you can publish it again later.", buttons "Cancel" and "Go back to this version" (primary md); success toast "Your website is back to the earlier version."
4. Section "Take offline" (only when live): SettingsSection row with a danger-outline button "Take offline" opening 8.7.

### 8.9 Editor and Pages updates

**8.9.1 Editor "Page" tab additions** (below the existing fields, same panel styling)
1. Section label "Search results" (12/700 caps, margin-top 8). Fields: "Page title" Input with counter (helper "Shown as the blue link in Google"), "Page description" Textarea 3 rows with counter, then the **search preview** component (8.9.2), then "Hide this page from Google" switch (helper "Visitors can still open it if they have the link"). The homepage shows helper under title "Your homepage title also uses the Website title from Settings when this is empty."
2. Switch "Show on my website" (default on). When off the page is hidden (`is_hidden`): not published, not in the menu, not in the sitemap. The homepage's switch is disabled and on with helper "Your homepage always shows."
3. Replace the old status row ("Status: Draft") with a `SiteStatus compact` plus a 14 `--text-muted` sentence "This page will go live when you publish." (or "This page is hidden and will not go live.").

**8.9.2 Search preview component** (`SearchPreview`)
- Card: bg `--surface`, 1px `--border`, radius 16, padding 16; a 12 caps label "How it may look in Google" (margin-bottom 12); a segmented toggle (Phone, Computer; default Phone; height 36) aligned right of the label.
- Result block (max-width 600 on Computer, 100% on Phone): top row flex gap 10, centre: favicon circle 28 (1px `--border`, logo or first letter), then column: site name 14/20 `--text` and address line 12/16 `--text-muted` formatted `rosebakery.get-on.tech › about-us` truncated.
- Title: 20/26 weight 400, colour `#1A0DAB` (dark mode `#8AB4F8`), margin-top 6, max one line on Computer with ellipsis at 600 px; two lines allowed on Phone. Underline on hover only.
- Description: 14/22 colour `#4D5156` (dark mode `#BDC1C6`), margin-top 4, clamp to 2 lines on Phone and 2 lines on Computer; empty shows muted italic "No description yet. Google will pick some text from your page."
- Counters (under the fields, not inside the preview): 12 `--text-muted` "{n}/60" for titles, "{n}/160" for descriptions, with a 4 px bar beneath each (track `--border`, fill grey below the minimum length, `--success` in the recommended range, `--accent` above it, never blocking input; hard limits 100 and 300 characters).
- The preview updates live while typing (no debounce).

**8.9.3 Social image** is not editable per page in this release (remove from the page tab), only at site level. The schema keeps the page column for later.

**8.9.4 Pages list updates**
- Each row's status badge now reflects the publish model: "Live" (included in the live site and unchanged), "Changed" (accent; edited since the last publish), "New" (neutral; not yet published), "Hidden" (neutral with eye-off icon). Hidden below 480 as before.
- Kebab menu gains "Hide from website" or "Show on website" (not shown for the homepage) and "View live page" (opens the live address of that page; hidden until the page is live).

### 8.10 Checklist updates (project Overview)
- "Add your logo and business details" now links to Settings, Business tab (completes as before).
- "Add a title and description for Google" is now active: links to Settings, Search tab; completes when `seo_site_title` and `seo_description` are both non-empty.
- "Publish your website" is now active and opens the Publish dialog directly (deep link `?publish=1`); completes on the first successful publish.
- Add a new item at the end, "Share your website" ("Tell your customers it is online."), enabled only after the first publish, opening the success view's share actions; completes when the user taps Copy, WhatsApp or Download QR. If never published, it shows "After you publish" in the right slot.
- "Turn on your contact form" links to Plugins with Contact highlighted (`/plugins?enable=contact`); it is complete when the Contact plugin is on.
- "Add a contact form to a page" links to `pages/{homepageId}?panel=add&tab=ready`; it is complete when any page has a contact form block.
- Items "Use your own domain" and "Connect Google Analytics" stay as "Soon" or "Upgrade".

### 8.11 Other updates
- Website cards on the team dashboard: use `SiteStatus compact`; when live add a small "Open" icon button (external-link 18) next to the kebab that opens the live address; kebab menu gains "Open website" (when live) and "Publish".
- Preview route: the "Publish" button in its top bar is now the real `PublishButton`.
- Project sidebar bottom block: "Publish" uses `PublishButton`; when live and without changes it becomes "Open website".
- Quick find: add "Open live website" under the project group when live, and "Publish" as an action row.
- The wizard's final screen now offers, after creating the website, a secondary link "Publish later" and keeps the user on the Overview; no auto publish.

## 9. Safety and moderation UI

### 9.1 Review state for owners
When a publish is stopped for review the dialog shows the "Under review" InfoBox from 8.3; the Overview live card shows the "Under review" status. Never show the matched rules. Text used: "We are taking a quick look at your website before it goes live. This usually takes up to 1 working day. You do not need to do anything."

### 9.2 Public "Report this site" page `/report` (main domain, public layout with landing header and footer)
- Container 560 centred, padding 48 20 (64 20 from 768).
- Eyebrow "Report a problem" (14/700 caps `--primary`), H1 (32/40, 40/48 from 1024) "Report a website", sub 16 `--text-muted` margin-top 8 "Tell us about a website on Get-On that is a scam, copies someone else, or breaks our rules. We look at every report."
- Card (margin-top 32; padding 24, 32 from 640; radius 24; shadow card). Fields (gap 16):
  - "Website address" Input prefilled from `?site=` (accepts `rosebakery` or `rosebakery.get-on.tech` or a full URL; normalise to the name; validate against the pattern; helper "For example: rosebakery.get-on.tech").
  - "What is the problem?" radio cards, stacked rows (min-height 56, padding 12 16, radius 14, 1.5px `--border-strong`, flex gap 12, radio 22 at left): "It is a scam or tries to steal information" (scam), "It pretends to be another person or business" (impersonation), "It shows illegal content" (illegal), "It is harmful or hateful" (harmful), "It is spam" (spam), "Something else" (other). Selected: 2px `--primary`, bg `--primary-soft`.
  - "More details (optional)" Textarea (min-height 112, counter 0/1000).
  - "Your email (optional)" Input type email, helper "Only if you want us to reply. We will not share it with the website owner."
  - Hidden honeypot `company` and a signed time token (min 3 seconds, max 2 hours), Turnstile when keys exist.
  - Submit lg full width "Send report", loading "Sending...".
- Success state replaces the card content: 72 circle `--success-soft` with check 32; H2 "Thank you"; text 16 `--text-muted` "We have your report and will look at it as soon as we can. If the website is breaking our rules, we will take it offline."; secondary md button "Back to home".
- Errors: invalid address "We could not find a website with that address." (check against projects; never reveal state); rate limit (3 per hour per `ip_hash`) "You have sent a few reports already. Please try again a little later."
- On success: insert `abuse_reports`; email `ABUSE_EMAIL` through `lib/email.ts` (subject "New report: {name} ({reason})", body with all fields). If 3 or more reports for the same site come from different `ip_hash` values within 24 hours, automatically add a `site_flags` row of kind `report` and mark the project `review_state = 'pending'` for admin attention (does not take the site offline automatically).
- Metadata: title "Report a website | Get-On", `noindex`.

### 9.3 Admin console (`/admin`, internal)
- Only people whose email is in `ADMIN_EMAILS` may open it. Everyone else gets the standard 404 page, so the console cannot be found by guessing the address.
- It uses the dashboard shell (same sidebar and top bar as the rest of the app) with an extra "Admin" item at the bottom of the sidebar, marked with a small shield icon.
- **Overview** (`/admin`): three cards in a row (stack on mobile): "Live websites" (count of published sites), "Waiting for review" (count of `review_state = 'pending'` sites, link to the list) and "Reports today" (count of `abuse_reports` in the last 24 hours). Below them, a table of the sites that need attention: each row shows the website address, the owner email, the reason (reason text or "Reported"), the time and a button to open the site.
- **Site list** (`/admin/sites`): a search field ("Search by address or owner email") above a table with columns: website address, owner, status (Live, Not published, Under review, Suspended), last published, reports. Rows are sortable by last published and by reports. The search filters as you type. An empty result shows "No websites match that search."
- **Site details** (`/admin/sites/[siteId]`): the address, the owner, the current status, the publishing history (date, result, reference) and the flags for that site. Actions:
  - "Take offline" (danger outline): asks for a reason in a dialog (440 wide, H3 "Take {address} offline?", reason Textarea required, "Cancel" and "Take offline" danger md). The site is served the suspended page straight away and the owner sees the reason in the Publish dialog (8.3).
  - "Bring back online" (primary md): only when the site is suspended; it flips the pointer back to the previous live version and clears the flag.
  - "Ask for a review" (secondary md): sets `review_state = 'pending'` so the owner sees the "Under review" state.
  - "Approve and publish" (primary md): clears the review flag and publishes the current version.
  - "Remove a report" (ghost md) on each report row: marks the report as handled.
- Every action writes a row in `admin_audit_log` with the admin email, the action, the project id, the reason and the time. The audit log is visible on the site details page and in a dedicated "History" tab, newest first. Nothing in the console can change a website without a log entry.
- The console never shows the rules a site broke to the owner, and never shows the admin notes to anyone but the admins.
